answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Work waits on the ripple until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the quill of the next round. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, published publicly on failure, no identity may audit its own recruit. Reaching the haven of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
